'''Beldonna's League''', also known as '''Beldonna's Legion''', were a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that had formed under the leadership of [[Liiria Beldonna]], to whom they were fiercely loyal.

==History==
While the Beldonna's League drew most of their assignments from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they were generally complacent and willing to let criminal activities go unchecked in exchange for bribes. At times, the unit worked as peacekeepers, while in other instances as aggressors, depending solely on what they were hired to do. They could be found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> 

They were typically rude, obnoxious, and arrogant, often fighting to earn their living. Beldonna kept order thanks to her inspiring charisma and a strict set of rules, not tolerating misconduct. Arguments among the members were resolved in non-lethal duels.<ref name="SotEPG" /> 

They were eventually hired by Imperial [[Consul-General]] [[Gilad Halsek]] to augment the defense of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], as the Empire neglected sending more troops.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref><ref name="SotEPG" /> 

However by 3 ABY<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> they had not been called to action for years, and as a result, they were lazy, inactive and uninspired. To keep them busy, Beldonna used to take them to hunting expeditions to the [[Arblis Forest]] or the [[Koth Ice Cap]].<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Ten members of the League were staffing the [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150]] [[ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] that defended Kothlis each given time, along with loyal Imperial citizens. As this duty was considered boring, they were rotating every 40 [[Local day/Legends|days]].<ref name="SotEPG" /> One day, the mercenaries were with 17 [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[technician/Legends|technicians]] waiting for their replacement, when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[agent/Legends|agents]], disabling the [[Sensor pod/Legends|sensor pods]], sneaked into the control bunker to steal some parts. Right then, the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] arrived, carrying Liria along, coming for a surprise inspection. They tried to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] and capture the Rebels.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Ion Cannon Parts|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Around that time, there was a rumor that a crazy man, [[Gart (Human)|Gart]] discovered a [[Ganjuko graveyard]]. The bored mercenaries saw it an oportunity for adventure, as well as some income, if they could salvage the precious [[ganjuko]] beaks. They followed his traces to the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]] where they were engaged into a [[lightfight]] with [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[agent/Legends|agents]]. After that, they followed Gart with a group to a hidden valley in the [[Ragnook Mountains]] when they attacked the group; then a group of [[Bothan cult]]ists, wearing ganjuko skulls, joined the fight against everyone, as well as a few [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[hunting/Legends|hunters]] and ISB agents; it turned out that the Imperials were more interested in the [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] whose impact created the graveyard.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Ganjuko Graveyard|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
==Equipment==
By roughly [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] the Legion was 56 strong. Members wore black, form-fitting uniforms with silver braiding along the shoulders, leg seams, and collar. Each mercenary armed themselves differently according to their personality, but most wielded [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]].<ref name="SotEPG" />

An Imperial compound on Kothlis served as the group's base of operations at that time. Halsek paid them from the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] treasury and provided support facilities with a guest house converted as [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] for them. Several members were accomplished [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and the group had access to six [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="SotEPG" />
